title: Member community call
participants: Dani (staff), Priya Nair (member), Tom Becker (member), Elena Costa (member)

lines.name: Dani
lines.text: Hi everyone, thanks for joining the community call. I'm Dani from the Celeste team. We'd love to hear how the app is working for you this month, the good and the bad.

lines.name: Priya Nair
lines.text: I'm Priya. Honestly, my birth details are the big one for me. I fixed the spelling of my birth city, pressed continue, and my birth time went back to twelve noon. My rising sign changed and I didn't notice for a week, so every reading was wrong.

lines.name: Tom Becker
lines.text: Tom here. Same thing happened to me when I corrected my birth place. The time reset to twelve. I don't trust the edit screen any more, so I check my chart every single time I change anything.

lines.name: Elena Costa
lines.text: Elena. It happened to me too, twice this month. You save, and the time is just gone.

lines.name: Dani
lines.text: That's really useful, thank you. Anything else?

lines.name: Tom Becker
lines.text: Compatibility readings. I do one with my partner and it's gone as soon as I leave the screen. I'd love to keep them.

lines.name: Elena Costa
lines.text: And I'd love to add my transits to my phone's calendar, so I can see a tricky day coming next to my work meetings.

lines.name: Priya Nair
lines.text: To be fair, the daily reading is lovely now. It feels personal, and it's the first thing I open in the morning.

lines.name: Dani
lines.text: Lovely. I'll pass all of this on to the product team. Thanks, everyone.
